title: 楔子

content_zh:
矗立在冰天雪地中的燕城好似成了与世隔绝的孤岛，被大梁的将士们团团包围。
为首的年轻将军银甲裹身，腥红披风招展于身后，手一抬，吐出比冰雪还要冷的两个字：“攻城！”
随着这两个字吐出，顿时就是一片杀声震天。
早已摇摇欲坠的城墙上一阵骚动，紧接着传来北齐将领的冷喝声：“邵将军，你瞧瞧这是谁，再下令攻城不迟！”
话音落，一个女子被人押着立于城墙之上。
那女子鸦黑长发拢在耳后，露出一张光洁素净的面庞。北风如刀割着她柔嫩的脸，使唇更红，脸更白，犹如一朵封存于寒冰中的玉芙蓉，虽素净，却格外灼人眼。
场面顿时一静。
年轻俊美的银甲将军神情没有一丝动容，手再次抬起——
城下大军又上前一步，那压抑却势在必得的气势迫得城墙上的人心惊胆战。
北齐将领一把扯过女子，推到身前，气急败坏喊道：“邵将军，你看清楚，这可是你婆娘。只要你退兵，我保她安然无恙，如若不然，你婆娘可就要没命了！”
年轻将军一愣。
身侧一位下属低声道：“将军，那确实是您夫人。”
年轻将军勒着缰绳，深深看了城墙上的女子一眼。
原来，这就是他的妻。
似是感受到男子的目光，城墙上的女子眸光微转，与他遥遥对视。
北地屡被齐人肆虐抢夺，而今竟还被夺了城池，不知洒下多少将士的血才有了今日的收复之战，又怎会因她一人而停下脚步？
她虽是女子，这点民族气节还是有的。
而那个令齐人闻风丧胆的年轻将军，今日她才第一次看清模样的夫君，亦不可能因她放弃收复山河的机会。
女子嘴张了张。
天太冷，又许久不曾开口，一时间竟吐不出一个字来。

念头才闪过，她的视线中一支利箭由远及近攸地放大，紧接着就是剧痛传来。
她下意识垂头，就见胸前鲜血喷薄而出，热血带来的暖意在寒风中很快凝结消散。
这混蛋，竟连一句大义凛然的话都没给她机会说出来！
迎接死亡的那一刻，女子恨恨地想。
“将军——”
年轻将军身侧的下属忍不住喊了一声。
年轻将军神色平静收回弓，垂眸遮去眼底的歉疚，冷冷吐出先前说过的两个字：“攻城！”
明康二十五年初春，大梁燕城收复。靖安侯次子，北征将军邵明渊受封冠军侯，凯旋归京。
而他的妻子乔氏，一腔热血永远留在了燕城城墙上。

content_en:
Yancheng, standing in the ice and snow, seemed to be an isolated island, surrounded by Daliang soldiers.
The young general at the head was wrapped in silver armor, with a scarlet cloak fluttering behind him. He raised his hand and uttered two words that were colder than ice and snow: "Attack the city!"
As soon as these two words were uttered, there was a sudden sound of killing.
There was a commotion on the already crumbling city wall, and then came the cold shout of the Northern Qi general: "General Shao, look who this is, it's not too late to order an attack on the city!"
As soon as he finished speaking, a woman was escorted and stood on the city wall.
The woman's long black hair was tucked behind her ears, revealing a smooth and pure face. The north wind cut her tender face like a knife, making her lips redder and her face whiter, like a jade hibiscus sealed in the ice. Although it was pure, it was particularly glaring.
The scene suddenly fell silent.
The young and handsome general in silver armor looked unmoved and raised his hand again——
The army under the city took another step forward, and the suppressed but inevitable momentum made the people on the city wall tremble with fear.
The Northern Qi general grabbed the woman, pushed her in front of him, and shouted angrily: "General Shao, please see clearly, this is your mother-in-law. As long as you retreat, I will keep her safe. If not, your mother-in-law will die!"
The young general was stunned.
A subordinate beside him whispered: "General, that is indeed your wife."
The young general reined in the reins and took a deep look at the woman on the wall.
It turns out that this is his wife.
As if feeling the man's gaze, the woman on the wall turned her eyes slightly and looked at him from a distance.
The Northland was repeatedly plundered by the Qi people, and now the city was taken away. I don't know how much blood of soldiers was shed to achieve today's battle of recovery. How could it stop because of her alone?
Although she is a woman, she still has some national integrity.
As for the young general who made everyone in Qi fearful, she had just seen her husband clearly for the first time today. There was no way she would give up the opportunity to regain the country because of her.
The woman opened her mouth.
It was too cold, and I hadn't spoken for a long time, so I couldn't utter a word for a while.
As soon as the thought flashed through her eyes, a sharp arrow zoomed in from far to near, followed by severe pain.
She lowered her head subconsciously and saw blood spurting out from her chest. The warmth brought by the blood quickly condensed and dissipated in the cold wind.
This bastard didn't even give her a chance to say a righteous word!
The woman thought bitterly as she faced death.
"General——"
The subordinate beside the young general couldn't help shouting.
The young general calmly took back his bow, lowered his eyes to hide the guilt in his eyes, and coldly uttered the two words he had said before: "Attack the city!"
In the early spring of the 25th year of Mingkang, Yancheng in Daliang was recovered. Shao Mingyuan, the second son of the Marquis of Jingan and the general of the Northern Expedition, was awarded the title of Champion Marquis and returned to Beijing in triumph.
And his wife Qiao's passion will remain on the walls of Yancheng forever.
